name: @avatark/canonical-event-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 18's canonical-event-integration domain: CanonicalEventIdentity/Definition, activation conditions, mandated facts (semantic, never renderer-shaped), projection scope (real Sprint 16 spatial-hierarchy ids), WorldInstanceCanonicalProjectionState (per-instance, mutable-by-projection-only), VisitorCanonicalEventWitness. No implementations, no repository write method on CanonicalEventDefinition at all -- Canon immutability is structural, not conventional.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
